methodology: First-pass verse-specific triage. No independent primary-text collation or historical attestation established; no candidate is published. Provisional no-specific-parallel is not a claim of universal absence.

records.topic: Leaders of ʿAd accuse Hūd of foolishness and falsehood
records.notes: No securely identified pre-Islamic text reproducing this speech; search Arabian epigraphic context without treating generic prophetic rejection as direct parallel.

records.topic: Hūd rejects accusation of foolishness and identifies himself as messenger
records.notes: No source-specific earlier account of this exchange established; generic prophetic-defense motifs are insufficient.

records.topic: Hūd conveys divine messages and claims trustworthy counsel
records.notes: Compare prophetic messenger/counsel formulae only as broad literary motifs, not evidence for a historical ʿAd text.

records.topic: Hūd recalls succession after Noah and unusual bodily stature
records.notes: Investigate pre-Islamic Arabian genealogy and ancient giant traditions; Genesis 6:4 is at most a loose giant motif, not identification of ʿAd.

records.topic: Community objects to sole worship of God and asks for threatened punishment
records.notes: Explore generic anti-idolatry polemic in Hebrew prophetic texts; do not assert identical narrative or dated source for Hūd.

pending_questions: Search dated pre-Islamic South Arabian and North Arabian inscriptions for ʿAd without assuming identification.
Investigate whether any securely dated Jewish, Christian, or Arabian text attests Hūd or this speech; distinguish motifs from historical parallels.
Reconcile pending PRs #238–246 into one authoritative coverage ledger and inspect ancient_sources RLS before publishing.
